name: 83634 · Kuna, ID
findings: ZIP 83634 (Kuna) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83634 (Kuna) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
